rules.name: Preparing for the Minor
rules.desc: Students must complete a first-year course set or test into second year or higher in the language of interest.

rules.name: Core Courses
rules.desc: Complete at least one of the listed Core Courses for a minimum of 4 units.

rules.name: Language Study
rules.desc: At least 8 units, second year or beyond (not including conversation/oral communication). Up to three BOSP and SLE units may be considered in consultation with the faculty advisor.

rules.name: Literature Study
rules.desc: At least 7 units in literature courses taught in a DLCL department, East Asian Languages and Cultures, Classics, Religious Studies, or other relevant departments determined in consultation with the faculty advisor.

rules.name: Electives
rules.desc: At least 4 units in a creative writing course or a course that foregrounds translation in departments, such as Anthropology, any DLCL department, English, East Asian Languages and Cultures, Classics, Linguistics, or Computer Science, determined in consultation with the faculty advisor.

rules.name: Capstone Project
rules.desc: Students must complete a capstone project: a significant translation and/or translation studies project (e.g., 20 pages of prose, ten poems, or a similar appropriate amount to be determined in consultation with the minor advisor). This work may be carried out under the supervision of an instructor in a required course.
